newsitem.title: FINLAND: Kemira plans agro j/v with China's Zhanhua.
newsitem.headline: Kemira plans agro j/v with China's Zhanhua.

text.p: Finnish chemicals group Kemira Oy said in a statement on Wednesday its Kemira Agro business group had signed a letter of intent to establish a joint venture with Zhanhua Enterprises Group Co in China.

Kemira's ownership stake in the plant nutrients joint venture would be 55 percent of the share capital and Zhanhua's 45 percent, Kemira said, adding the companies had agreed to not publish at this stage the cost of the investment.

"Kemira Agro has decided to further strengthen its presence on China's growing plant nutrients market," Kemira said, adding this strategy was based on the Chinese government's stated objective to aim for as high a self-sufficiency ratio as possible in agriculture and related industries.
The joint venture company would be located in Zhanjiang in the Guangdong province. @
It would consist of a phosphoric acid plant and the modernisation of a fertilisers plant.
After the investments, the facility would produce some 200,000 tonnes per year of nutrients. Production is scheduled to start early in 1999, Kemira said.
